Friktion is a decentralized finance protocol built on the Solana blockchain. Friktion offers automated options vaults that run options strategies on behalf of depositors.

Thetanuts is a decentralized options protocol. Thetanuts operates on-chain options products without a centralized intermediary.

Rocketpool is a decentralized liquid staking protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain. Rocketpool lets users stake ETH without running their own validator node. Rocketpool node operators post RPL tokens as collateral. Rocketpool issues rETH as a liquid staking token representing staked ETH.
